headline: GOLD NEAR 13-MONTH LOW AS U.S. RETAIL SALES SLOW — $3,845 Spot as Dollar Holds 103.5; Fed Hike Bets Cap Recovery
snippet: Gold hovered near $3,845 per ounce on Tuesday morning after U.S. retail sales came in below consensus, adding a new data catalyst to a multi-week selloff driven by a 103.5+ dollar index and rising Fed rate-hike bets; silver steadied near $47.43 after plunging 4.5% on Monday to its lowest level since November 4, 2025.

headline: GSP RESOURCE HITS 137m AT 0.15% Cu AT HIGHLAND VALLEY — First Drilling at Mer Property Since 1971; 6km From Teck's Operating Mine
snippet: GSP Resource (TSX-V: GSPR) confirmed a new near-surface porphyry copper-molybdenum zone at its Mer property in BC's Highland Valley, with drill hole ME-26-04 returning 0.15% Cu over 137 metres including 0.30% Cu over 40 metres — the first drilling at the site since 1971 and located 6 km west of Teck's Valley Pit at Highland Valley Copper Operations.

headline: USA RARE EARTH TUMBLES 11% ON WILLIAM BLAIR DOWNGRADE — Feedstock Shortages Push Q3 Revenue to $3M vs $14M Consensus; Sector Selloff Hits Critical Metals -13%, MP Materials -5%
snippet: William Blair cut USA Rare Earth (USAR) from Outperform to Market Perform on Monday after Q3 revenue came in at $3 million versus a $14 million consensus estimate, citing chronic feedstock shortages constraining magnet production; the downgrade spread to the broader sector with Critical Metals off 13% and MP Materials off 5%, ahead of a closely watched Trump-Xi meeting.

headline: COPPER HEADS FOR BIGGEST WEEKLY DROP SINCE MARCH — LME Falls to $13,211/t on AI Selloff, China Weakness; Yangshan Premium Hits Record Despite Tight Exchange Stocks
snippet: LME three-month copper slid to $13,211 per tonne on Monday, its lowest level since July, as AI-sector investment concerns and weak Chinese economic data pressured base metals; the week is shaping up as copper's worst since March despite Yangshan premiums hitting record highs on tight Shanghai exchange stocks of just 27,642 tonnes — the lowest since December 2023.

headline: TALAMORE MINING DRILLS 50 MORE HOLES AT SUPREMO EXTENSION — 6,719m Infill Advances Coffee Gold Project Toward Resource Expansion in Yukon
snippet: Talamore Mining (TSX: TALA) released assay results from 50 additional holes at the Supremo Extension zone of its Coffee Gold project in Yukon, covering 6,719 metres across 37 reverse-circulation and 13 diamond drill holes as part of a planned 25,000-metre infill program designed to expand the project's resource base.

headline: HELIOSTAR EXPANDS SAN AGUSTIN TO 25,000-30,000m — East Wall and Corner Zones Return Oxide Gold Over 200m From Pit Edge; $9.75M Budget
snippet: Heliostar Metals (TSX: HSTR) expanded its San Agustin mine drill program in Durango, Mexico to 25,000-30,000 metres under a US$9.75 million budget after the Corner Expansion and East Wall zones returned consistent shallow oxide gold mineralization extending more than 200 metres beyond the current reserve edge — a potential mine-life extension scenario at the already-producing mine.

headline: GOLD IS FALLING AS INFLATION RISES — What It Means for the Sector When the Textbook Hedge Breaks Down
snippet: Kitco's latest op-ed examines the counterintuitive dynamic of gold breaking below $4,000 during hot CPI data, arguing that rising rate-hike expectations from a 0.4% October CPI print and an approximately 86% market-implied probability of a December Fed hike are overriding gold's traditional inflation-hedge function — with December FOMC the next key catalyst.

headline: PUREPOINT + ISOENERGY APPROVE 7,700m AT DORADO — Nova Uranium Discovery in Athabasca Basin Gets 2027 Expansion Campaign
snippet: The Purepoint Uranium-IsoEnergy joint venture has approved a 7,700-metre drilling program to advance the Nova uranium discovery at the Dorado project in Saskatchewan's eastern Athabasca Basin, targeting structural corridors identified by a completed airborne MobileMT geophysical survey in one of the basin's most active exploration corridors.

headline: STANDARD URANIUM CONFIRMS REE ENRICHMENT AT ROCAS — Up to 9.83% TREO at Surface in Winter Drilling; Saskatchewan Project Advances to Phase 2
snippet: Standard Uranium (TSX-V: STND) confirmed anomalous uranium and high-grade rare earth element mineralization up to 9.83% TREO at surface in winter reconnaissance drilling at the Rocas project in Saskatchewan; all four holes intersected elevated radioactivity and graphitic structures, and results will inform the design of a Phase 2 program.

headline: NASDAQ SLIDES 2.5% ON NVIDIA CHIP BAN — Tech Selloff Channels Capital Into Dollar and Bonds; Gold, Copper Both Under Pressure Tuesday
snippet: The Nasdaq Composite fell 2.5% on Tuesday after Nvidia flagged regulatory complications from new chip export restrictions, driving investors toward US Treasuries and the dollar index to 103.5+; the concurrent flight from risk assets added fresh headwinds to gold and base metals already down sharply from their 2026 peaks.

headline: AMERICAN PACIFIC DRILLS GOLD IN 3 OF 4 HOLES AT MADISON — 800m Step-Out From Historic Montana Mines Confirms Zone Continuity
snippet: American Pacific Mining (OTC: USGDF) announced gold mineralization in three of four exploration holes at its Madison project in southwest Montana, testing targets up to 800 metres from historical mine workings; assay results are pending, with the company targeting a resource update later in 2026.
